lines.t: You opened eyes of the blind
You made the lame rise
Spoke a word to the deaf and they heard your voice
Miracles traced in the dust of the earth
But you were reaching deeper than our broken flesh and bones
You spoke of another blindness in your fold
Hearts without light, love grown cold
We thought we were whole, we thought we were wise
But you saw the sickness hidden in our lives
Open my eyes so I can see
My sickness laid bare in the light of your mercy
You came for the blind, you came for the ill
To shatter my pride and to bend my will
Till I look and feel and hear like You
A new heart beating in all I do
True wholeness is this, to be one with You
In union with God in Yahushua made new
You walk through the walls of the wounded in soul
The proud in their strength, the broken made whole
We stand in our knowledge and call ourselves well
But you read every line that we write on our own hearts of stone
You knock at the door, we keep double locked
You wait in the rain while we talk in the dark
We hide in our wisdom but you see it all
You call us to fall that we might finally stand tall
Open my eyes so I can see
My sickness lay bare in the light of your mercy
You came for the blind, you came for the ill
To shatter my pride and to bend my will
Till I look and feel and hear like You
A new heart beating in all I do
True wholeness is this, to be one with You
In union with God in Yahushua made new
The greatest sign is not eyes made to see the sun
But a heart of stone undone
When your fire melts the hardest place
And every beat keeps time with grace
You take the fragments of who I've been
Wash them clean and draw me in
I lay down my holdings, confess I'm blind
And fight my life in losing mine
I trade my opinions for the light of your face
My scattered desires for the fire of your embrace
You walk through my ruins with healing in your hands
Calling dead things to rise, teaching ashes to dance
I call myself healthy, but you know I'm weak
You meet me in truth when I finally speak
You are the physician, the shepherd, the door
Wholeness himself, and I need nothing more
Open my eyes so we can see
My sickness laid bare in the light of Your mercy
You came for the blind, You came for the ill
To shatter my pride and to bend my will
Till I look and feel and hear like You
A new heart beating in all I do
True wholeness is this, to be one with You
In union with God in Yahushua made new
The highest wonder under the sun
Is a new heart given
Through the crucified one
